description: Swap the checkout service onto the new internal payments API

_seeded_flaw.message: the swap depends on a booked window that is never probe-verified against live state

_doc: Refactor scenario: the plan assumes the maintenance window it booked actually holds, but the precondition carries no probe, so the re-gate cannot verify it. The unverified_dependencies heuristic flags it; revision 2 adds an env-var probe to the precondition.
